During the [[Great Galactic War]] of [[3681 BBY]]&ndash;[[3653 BBY]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] slid into a severe '''economic depression''' that confounded the government's efforts to fight in the conflict against the invading [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. After the conclusion of the war and the signing of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], the Republic found itself unable to rise out of the depression and was therefore hampered in its efforts to rebuild in the aftermath of the Great War. The depression continued throughout the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and into the [[Galactic War]].
